meta.title: Happy Birthday, Darp
meta.subtitle: A scrapbook of wishes
meta.description: A collection of heartfelt messages and memories from people who love you

boxes.message:
Nannu beta,

Janmadin bohot bohot mubarak ho meri bachi. ❤️

Main dekh raha hoon tujhe. Har ek pal, har ek kadam pe main bilkul tere saath hoon. Kabhi yeh mat sochna ki Papa door hain—main tere aas-paas hi hoon, teri har muskaan mein, teri har himmat mein, aur tere aage aane wali har ek rukawat aur mushkil ko hatane ke liye.

Mujhe tujhpar bohot, bohot zyada garv hai meri gudiya. Tu kitni samajhdar, kitni bahadur aur kitni shaandar beti ban rahi hai. Zindagi mein jo bhi tu karna chahti hai, bina dare aage badhna. Mujhe tujhpar poora vishwas hai, aur main chahta hoon ki tu bhi khudpar utna hi vishwas rakhe. Tu har cheez sambhal legi, aur bohot aage jayegi.

Aur haan... Mummy ko zyada satana mat! Unka dhyaan rakhna, unko hamesha khush rakhna. Naina ka dhyaan rakhna, uski taakat banke rehna. Aur in sabse bhi zaroori—apna khudka dhyaan rakhna. Khana time pe khana, khush rehna, aur hamesha aise hi chamakna.

Mera aashirwad aur mera dher saara pyaar hamesha, har pal tere saath hai. Tu meri sabse badi khushi hai.

Hamesha tera,
Papa 💙
boxes.poem:
Nannu meri jaan, tu kabhi na darna,
Aage hi aage tu bas badhte chalna.
Haath sar par hai mera, main saath khada hoon,
Har mushkil se aage, tere paas khada hoon.

Garv hai tujhpar, vishwas rakh khud par,
Roshan karegi tu jahaan ko badh kar.
Muskurati reh gudiya, khushiyon se sajna,
Har dua mein meri bas tera hi sahara.

boxes.message:
Happy Birthday, My Dear Nanu! ❤️🎂

My dear princess, on your special day, Mummy and Daddy want to shower you with all our love and blessings.

May God bless you with endless happiness, good health, success and prosperity. May you achieve every dream you have ever wished for and reach the highest heights of success in life.

I pray from the bottom of my heart that life always brings you beautiful opportunities, happiness and wonderful moments. May you have the strength to overcome every challenge and the courage to fulfil all your dreams.

Mummy's blessings are always with you, today, tomorrow and forever. May you always keep smiling, stay healthy and shine brighter with every passing year.

Never forget that you are our biggest happiness, our pride and one of the most precious gifts God has given us.

Your Mummy loves you more than words can ever express, and Daddy loves you immensely too. Both of us will always stand beside you, support you and pray for your happiness and success.

May you touch every height of success and may all your dreams come true.

Lots and lots of love, hugs and blessings from Mummy and Daddy.

Love you forever, our darling daughter! ❤️❤️

Happy birthday 😂🫶🏻

(tujhe jhelti hu utna bas nhi tha jo abh ye bhi karna pad rha hai)

Jokes apart, you're the best sister and my real partner in crime. Love you always! 💕

— Naina

boxes.relationship: Everyone Wants Her as Their Best Friend
boxes.message:
happy birthdayyyyy babyyygirll,
so let's start with how i love you being so competitive, 
we talk about this on a yearly basis, usually on your birthday or mine, you remember the day you sat next to me in class, not because you chose to, but because you'd fought with your regular partners, i said "anyway, you'll only be here for today" and you said "no, i'll sit every day." which, in retrospect, was such a you thing to say. 
it's always going to be my fav story of ours to tell, the kind they expect from couples.
i think about the early days a lot. the two of us on roads we didn't know, literally just walking before and after classes just for the hell of it. no destination, no vehicle, no plan, just walking because we felt like it and being slightly unhinged and completely okay with it. those very roads led us to no special venues, but they sure led me to you. *drum roll*. those stories feel sacred in the way that only the really specific, really small things do.

but here's what i've been thinking about lately, we spend so much time honouring the early stories that we sometimes forget to notice what's happening right now. and right now is equally magical if not more. right now is scooty rides home, taking the scooty out of golden nest for the first time only to immediately get caught by traffic police and deciding *that* was prime selfie time, rajasthani delicacies, and you-plus-naina equalling the sisters-I-didn't-get-at-home package. right now is garba, which is — without question — the most i see you in any given year, and somehow always not enough. right now is two people becoming who they were always going to be, just closer to it than before.

fellow 3 mulank. make of that what you will.

you are a wonderful, beautiful, brave woman. and i know you're figuring it out. i can already see us living those lives, the villas, the NGOs, the Airbnb business, the trips that make us real travellers and not just tourists. We are genuinely getting closer to all of it every single day.

i love that how beyond the surface you are. that we can talk about feminism and mythology and the absolute state of things and you get as angry as i am about everything that deserves anger. that is incredibly rare and i do not take it for granted.

also, capitalism is going to end us and we both know it and i love that we hate it together.


you're so loved. 🤎

- A

boxes.message:
Happy Birthday, Darpii! <3

Thank you so much for being there for me, for all your love, care, and support. I genuinely appreciate everything you do, even the little things, and I’m truly grateful to have you in my life. Keep smiling and always be happy! I hope you have a great exam, and I’m sure you’ll absolutely rock it. Don’t worry or stress too much; just believe in yourself. I know you’ll do amazing. Remember, I’m always there for you, no matter what. I wish you endless happiness, success, and everything your heart wishes for. You deserve all the good things in the world. Keep shining, keep smiling, and never change.

Love you so much! 🫶🏻
